trends.name: Layered necklace sets
trends.what: Pre-styled stacks of multiple necklaces sold as one set, including long sautoir-length pieces.
trends.evidence: A jeweler's fall trend report states layered necklace sets make up almost 33% of all orders by mid-August, climbing through September; a 2026 forecast notes sautoir-length necklaces creeping into the spotlight.
trends.idea: Promote existing layered necklace sets as ready-to-wear shopping picks for party season.

trends.name: Sea-inspired jewelry
trends.what: Shell, coral, pearl, and turquoise motifs evoking coastal escape.
trends.evidence: A major fashion title's 2026 trend roundup calls out sea-inspired baubles as a moment as fashion craves whimsy and escape.
trends.idea: Create a coastal jewelry edit highlighting shell and turquoise pieces, with a note about an opportunity to add lucite accents.

trends.name: Zodiac and celestial motifs
trends.what: Zodiac medallions, constellations, and celestial symbols as personal, spiritual jewelry.
trends.evidence: A fine-jewelry trend guide calls zodiac/celestial jewelry 2026's most personal trend, transcending fad status to become modern classics.
trends.idea: Build a zodiac jewelry hub page linking existing sign-specific gift guides and product pages.

trends.name: Quiet luxury minimalism
trends.what: Understated, dainty gold jewelry meant for everyday wear, prized for intention over impulse.
trends.evidence: Trend commentary states the jewelry trends of 2025-2026 reward intention over impulse, with maximalism and quiet luxury growing simultaneously.
trends.idea: Push dainty, minimalist pieces as a New Year 'edit your jewelry box' capsule collection.

trends.name: Coquette aesthetic
trends.what: Soft, feminine pearl and bow-adjacent jewelry blending girlycore with confident softness.
trends.evidence: Style press describes the 2026 coquette evolution as confidence in softness, a fusion of girlycore and Old English elegance with balletcore touches, described as peaking on TikTok and Pinterest.
trends.idea: Feature existing pearl choker and bracelet pieces in a coquette styling guide while noting the gap in bow/ribbon-motif jewelry for future development.

trends.name: Chunky, sculptural statement jewelry
trends.what: Bold, oversized sculptural metal jewelry and body harnesses for AW2026 statement dressing.
trends.evidence: Stylists quoted in a trend feature list sculptural gold and silver pieces, mixed metals, layered necklaces and chunky cuffs as 'in', echoed by AW2026 runway recaps.
trends.idea: Promote body harnesses and layered chain pieces for party season styling, while noting a gap in chunky cuff bracelets.
